rules.name: chest_pain_cardiac
rules.rationale: Chest pain with radiation or associated cardiac symptoms suggests acute coronary syndrome

rules.name: difficulty_breathing_rest
rules.rationale: Dyspnea at rest is always an emergency until proven otherwise

rules.name: meningitis_triad
rules.rationale: Classic meningitis presentation requiring immediate evaluation

rules.name: stroke_signs
rules.rationale: FAST criteria for stroke — time-critical emergency

rules.name: anaphylaxis
rules.rationale: Anaphylaxis requires immediate epinephrine and emergency care

rules.name: seizure_active
rules.rationale: Status epilepticus or first-time seizure requires emergency evaluation

rules.name: head_injury_severe
rules.rationale: Head injury with neurological signs suggests traumatic brain injury

rules.name: high_fever_confusion
rules.rationale: High fever with altered mental status may indicate sepsis or encephalitis

rules.name: suicidal_ideation
rules.rationale: Any expression of suicidal intent requires immediate crisis intervention

rules.name: child_high_fever
rules.rationale: High fever in infants/young children has lower threshold for emergency

rules.name: pregnancy_emergency
rules.rationale: Obstetric emergencies are time-critical for both mother and baby
